title: eludite.debug.enable_breakpoints input
description: Enable or disable breakpoints (brief 0077): with `all`, every line and function breakpoint (Debug > Enable All Breakpoints, Disable All Breakpoints); otherwise the breakpoint at `path` and `line` (default: the active document's caret line), toggled when `enabled` is absent (Ctrl+F9, Debug.EnableBreakpoint). Answers the state.
